Design a Data Visualization Training Program for Your Company.

[/dfd_heading][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Visualizing data — designing it simply, aesthetically, and with a well-structured story — is hard. It’s hard for professional data visualizers; it’s certainly hard for analysts, researchers, communication experts, and anyone who is immersed in data but not trained in design. That's why we started our data visualization training workshops.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]The Datalabs Agency is a creative data visualization and visual analytics agency. Since 2013, we've trained staff members in companies and government agencies in data visualization and visual storytelling, both remotely and on-site, anywhere in the world. Since then, our data visualizers have spoken at conferences, engaged in one-to-one training with C-Suite executives, and have held workshops for thousands of About Our Data Visualization Training

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="10" screen_mobile_spacer_size="10"][vc_column_text]Our agency is often engaged to provide on-going data visualization training for mid- to large-sized corporations or for government agencies at every level: Federal, State, and Municipal. Data visualization is evolving fast, and access to data viz resources and tools has never been greater. Still, the need for data visualization skills in areas like reporting, business intelligence, and visual communication is growing day by day. Thinking more strategically about data is now a necessity. But data is not easily understood if it’s not visual; if it’s not communicated through a story. That’s why the Datalabs Agency consults into transformation projects. It’s why we assist corporations undergoing disruption and why communications & strategy teams seek us out to be a part of the needed change. That's exactly why executives hire us to train them and their staff in the best practice data visualization principles. Datalabs can provide data visualization training in many forms. Current session rates are on our data visualisation workshop pricing page. Just let us know if you’d like us to offer training as part of your organization’s ongoing, business-as-usual employee education. We can also contribute as a part of a larger group of outside consultants (we play nicely with others!). Finally, the Datalabs Agency can offer this training remotely via Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Webex or on-site workshops, bringing our expertise directly to your Learn from our experts and work with Datalabs

Design a Data Visualization Training Program for Your Company.

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]Visualizing data — designing it simply, aesthetically, and with a well-structured story — is hard. It’s hard for professional data visualizers; it’s certainly hard for analysts, researchers, communication experts, and anyone who is immersed in data but not trained in design.

That’s why we started our data visualization training workshops.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]The Datalabs Agency is a creative data visualization and visual analytics agency. Since 2013, we’ve trained staff members in companies and government agencies in data visualization and visual storytelling, both remotely and on-site, anywhere in the world. Since then, our data visualizers have spoken at conferences, engaged in one-to-one training with C-Suite executives, and have held workshops for thousands of people.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=””][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1691034930092{background-color: #ffffff !important;}”][vc_column]

Onsite & digitally facilitated...

Our Four Main Workshops

[vc_column_text]Datalabs offers a data visualization basics workshop that’s perfect for everyone just starting out in data design and visual storytelling — we call it, “Introduction to Data Visualization: Tools & Techniques”. From there, we offer additional workshops that incorporate the teachings and exercises in workshops focusing on dashboard, report, and presentation design.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″]

About Our Data Visualization Training

[vc_column_text]Our agency is often engaged to provide on-going data visualization training for mid- to large-sized corporations or for government agencies at every level: Federal, State, and Municipal. Data visualization is evolving fast, and access to data viz resources and tools has never been greater. Still, the need for data visualization skills in areas like reporting, business intelligence, and visual communication is growing day by day. Thinking more strategically about data is now a necessity. But data is not easily understood if it’s not visual; if it’s not communicated through a story.

That’s why the Datalabs Agency consults into transformation projects. It’s why we assist corporations undergoing disruption and why communications & strategy teams seek us out to be a part of the needed change. That’s exactly why executives hire us to train them and their staff in the best practice data visualization principles.

Datalabs can provide data visualization training in many forms. Current session rates are on our data visualisation workshop pricing page. Just let us know if you’d like us to offer training as part of your organization’s ongoing, business-as-usual employee education. We can also contribute as a part of a larger group of outside consultants (we play nicely with others!). Finally, the Datalabs Agency can offer this training remotely via Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Webex or on-site workshops, bringing our expertise directly to your offices.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column]
